svg.title: Veneto study map
svg.desc: Orientation map with representative study locations and selected rivers and towns. Country and state outlines are geographic context, not appellation boundaries. No vineyard parcels or elevation model are implied. 1: Veneto; 2: Negrar; 3: Sant'Ambrogio di Valpolicella; 4: Asolo; 5: Treviso; 6: Bardolino; 7: Custoza; 8: Gambellara; 9: Breganze; 10: Lison; 11: Albaredo d'Adige; 12: Cortesi-Orni-Oneste

g.text: Light markers: study locations · dark markers: geographic context · teal: water

text.tspan: Follow the land. Compare the wines.
Open this map in the Codex for terroir, grapes, growing, cellar
choices and service. Dots locate places; they do not define a wine

g.text: Natural Earth · GeoNames CC BY 4.0 · representative locations · no appellation boundaries
